about_short_description.short_description: Better Auth provides tools for developers to simplify how developers manage user authentication.

product.name: Better Auth Framework
product.description: A TypeScript authentication and authorization framework providing built-in support for email/password, social sign-on, session management, and extensible plugins.

product.name: Email and Password Authentication
product.description: Built-in support for user authentication using email and password with session and account management features.

product.name: Social Sign-On
product.description: Support for multiple OAuth providers allowing users to sign in with accounts like Google, GitHub, Apple, and more.

product.name: Two-Factor Authentication Plugin
product.description: A plugin that adds multi-factor authentication capabilities to secure user accounts with an additional verification step.

product.name: Multi-Tenant Organization Management
product.description: Support for managing multiple organizations with members, teams, invitations, and access control within the authentication framework.
